draft.title: Migrate to PostgreSQL 16 — v3
sections: Summary: Database version upgrade delivering 20% faster queries, native JSON, and improved vacuum performance.
Impact: 5 min read-only window. Write queues buffer automatically. Rollback is a DNS flip to the old primary.
Migration Plan: Build PG16 replica → replay WAL → validate data → promote standby → switch DNS → decommission old primary.
Rollback Plan: Flip DNS back to PG14 primary. Write queues drain naturally. Total RPO < 1 s.
